questions.answer: Gradient = (6.4 - 1.6)/[(32.0 - 8.0) × 10⁻³] = 200 N m⁻¹. It is the spring constant. The limit of proportionality is 7.2 N. Beyond it F/x is not constant, so one constant k does not describe the curved region.

questions.tolerance: Accept 200 N m⁻¹ and 7.2 N to stated precision.

questions.answer: kA = 6.0/0.024 = 250 N m⁻¹; kB = 6.0/0.015 = 400 N m⁻¹, so B is stiffer. At 7.5 N, xA = 7.5/250 = 0.030 m or 30 mm. A 10.0 N prediction using the same k is unsafe because this is beyond A's limit of proportionality and its graph is no longer straight.
